title: Workspace Reasoning Economy Codex Runtime v1
goal: Add a bounded, CPU-only Codex runtime/bootstrap capability to the existing Workspace Control control-small runner class so Reasoning Economy can use the user's included ChatGPT Plus Codex allowance without API billing, GPU access, credential copying, or bypassing the v3 root allocator.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the live PR #627 capacity generation exactly: host max 3, PADataset max 2, Workspace Control max 1, reserved workspace-control slots 1.
Use only runner class workspace-control-control-small-v1 / scale set lambda-workspace-control-control-small; do not add or borrow any PADataset runner class.

Codex runtime is pinned to 0.155.1 and installed from the official OpenAI GitHub release artifact codex-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz with expected SHA-256 a0ef8b2debc3bf747e07b1a039354de31300ac0dcc2276498ba281470b5d9115.
Runtime and credentials persist only under /srv/workspace-ci/workspace-control/home; /home/atrott and sibling project roots remain inaccessible.
Codex configuration forces ChatGPT login and never enables API-key authentication or paid API fallback.
OPENAI_API_KEY is unset for every bootstrap/auth/account-read process.
Initial bootstrap performs no model inference and consumes no Codex reasoning tokens; it may only install/verify the CLI, perform login, and read account/rate-limit/usage state.
If login is absent, the only user-only action is one ChatGPT device-code authorization; no auth.json/token/cookie copy is required.
Account verification requires account.type=chatgpt and planType=plus and emits no email, user ID, account ID, access token, refresh token, or device code into durable receipts.
The trusted bootstrap workflow is inert until its exact default-branch blob is bound by a reviewed root-policy route.
Any new route is additive on workspace-control-control-small-v1 and cannot widen host/project concurrency, GPU visibility, Docker access, forbidden paths, or root privileges.
Repository validation and authoritative self-hosted exact-head validation pass before any live route activation.
Live activation uses the existing v3 root-policy/provisioner mechanism; no manual runner, arbitrary sidecar, or Workspace Shell authority bypass is used.
constraints: Do not modify or target lambda-padataset-scientific-single-gpu or lambda-padataset-scientific-single-gpu-2.
Do not touch either physical GPU UUID.
Do not copy /home/atrott/.codex or Research Engine Codex credentials into Workspace Control.
Do not use OPENAI_API_KEY, API-key login, purchased credits, pay-as-you-go, or paid resets.
Do not persist OAuth tokens in GitHub artifacts, logs, task capsules, repository files, or telemetry.
Do not make a workflow executable merely by adding it to a candidate branch; live root-policy trust must bind an exact default-branch blob.
Do not activate a root-policy generation that omits or regresses the live PR #627 reservation semantics.
Do not perform model inference during bootstrap or authentication validation.

stages.resume_condition: Workflow is repository-validated and cannot run without an explicit trusted route.
The inert workflow exists on workspace-control main at an exact reviewed blob SHA before route binding.
Compiled root policy preserves host=3/PADataset=2/WorkspaceControl=1/reserved=1 and exact route/class identity.
Codex runtime is installed in Workspace Control home, ChatGPT Plus auth is proven, account telemetry reads pass, and no model inference occurred.

evidence: PR #627 exact head passed self-hosted validation run 43720885039 / job 132832399435.
PR #627 Phase-B evidence records PHASE_B_FINAL_VERIFY=PASS and DUAL_SCIENCE_PLUS_CONTROL_READY=1.
Reasoning Economy live preflight on reserved runner proved Codex CLI is currently absent; all other fixture tests passed.
No Codex runtime or credentials have been installed for ci-workspace-control.
User explicitly instructed that the Reasoning Economy/Codex system be set up.
User explicitly required Workspace Control CPU capacity rather than PADataset scientific lanes.
User explicitly prohibited paid API usage.

remaining_work: Implement and repository-validate the inert pinned Codex bootstrap workflow.
Promote the inert workflow to main and bind its exact blob.
Add and validate the bootstrap route on the existing control-small class while preserving PR #627 capacity invariants.
Activate the additive route through the reviewed v3 root-policy mechanism.
Run bootstrap; if needed perform one device-code ChatGPT authorization.
Prove Plus auth and programmatic account/rate-limit/usage reads with zero model inference.
next_safe_action: Implement the inert lambda-ci-workspace-control-codex-bootstrap.yml workflow on this stacked branch. Reuse the exact same-repository PR-head and control-small isolation gates from the accepted control-validation workflow; pin Codex 0.155.1 and its official SHA-256; write runtime/CODEX_HOME only under the Workspace Control project home; force ChatGPT auth; perform no model inference; emit only a redacted receipt.
